quote: Lithium Argentina AG (“Lithium Argentina” or the “Company”) (TSX: LAR) (NYSE: LAR) today announced the closing of the $180 million strategic investment from Ganfeng Lithium Group Co., Ltd. (“Ganfeng”) through the issuance of a six-year unsecured convertible note (the “Note” or the “Strategic Investment”)… The Company’s joint venture with Ganfeng in respect of the consolidation of the Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes project (“PPG”) remains on track to be completed by the end of September 2026.
